verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API for managing sites, deploys and DNS programmatically, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404 on all candidate paths. The axis applies to a platform with a public API, so the lack of evidence makes this none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
